title: Gemini 4 Neon beat GPT-6.2 and Claude in my 25-task AI benchmark
text: Gemini 4 Neon beat GPT-6.2 and Claude in my 25-task AI benchmark Subscribe Sign in Playback speed × Share post Share post at current time Share from 0:00 0:00 / Gemini 4 Neon beat GPT-6.2 and Claude in my 25-task AI benchmark 🎙️ My late-2026 How I AI bench: GPT-6.2 disappointed me, Opus 5.5 is my least annoying daily driver, and Gemini 4 Neon is now my top pick Claire Vo Nov 25, 2026 Share Transcript We’re back in model release season, and I put the newest frontier models through my How I AI bench: 25 tasks across coding, writing, creative, video, prototyping, and personal-assistant work, with six models scored blind. I compare GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol, Claude Fable 5.2 and Opus 5.5, and Gemini 4 Neon and Carbon. I also walk through the SVG, animation, storybook, and prototype tests side by side and share a new eval I built from my own session data: the Claire Annoyance Bench. The dark-horse winner surprised me—and it wasn’t close. Listen or watch on YouTube , Spotify , or Apple Podcasts What you’ll learn: Why Gemini 4 Neon was the surprise winner of my 25-task benchmark How I blind-score models and blend in LLM-as-judge ratings Why coding no longer separates the frontier models How to build your own Annoyance Bench from your local agent sessions Why my favorite model to work with lost my blind test Where Fable 5.2 shines, and where I’d never use it The animated storybook build that blew my mind The hidden cost of a slow model, even a great one Brought to you by: Parallel —Web search built for AI scale Jira Product
